# 10. Privacy Model

Cooperative perception is inherently broadcast. Every PerceptionSummary that leaves a vehicle is received, in principle, by every conformant receiver within radio range. The privacy model is therefore not about confidentiality of individual messages; it is about what those messages are allowed to contain, how they are correlated across time, and what retention any receiver is permitted.

## 10.1 Data Minimization on the Wire

No O-CPS message, under any circumstance, MUST contain:

- The vehicle’s Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) or any derived identifier.
- The owner’s or driver’s name, license number, address, phone number, or any other personally identifiable information.
- A persistent vehicle identifier that survives certificate rotation.
- License plate data, whether the transmitter’s own or that of observed vehicles.
- Biometric data of any kind.
- Raw camera imagery or lidar point clouds.

The only identifier on the wire is the pseudonym certificate ID, which rotates per §9.1.2.

## 10.2 Localization of Data

O-CPS messages are geographically scoped by the GeoNetworking destination area (ITS-G5) or by the PC5 sidelink neighborhood. There is no wide-area broadcast of O-CPS messages and no central subscription service for O-CPS content. Any party that wishes to aggregate O-CPS data across a metropolitan scale MUST do so through the Telemetry channel (§8.7), subject to the retention limits below.

## 10.3 Retention Limits

A conforming O-CPS receiver MUST observe the following retention limits:

| **Data Type** | **Maximum Retention at Receiver** | **Exception** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PerceptionSummary (others’) | 60 seconds | None. |
| Intent (others’) | 30 seconds | None. |
| GroupState (foreign groups) | 60 seconds | None. |
| Attestation records | 30 seconds after last message from the same cert | None. |
| Misbehavior evidence | 30 days, at Misbehavior Authority only | Receiver MUST purge local copy after report transmission. |
| Aggregated road condition (Telemetry) | 90 days at operator, pre-anonymized before aggregation | Data MUST NOT be joined to identity outside the 30-day enrollment window. |

## 10.4 Opt-In for Telemetry

A vehicle MUST NOT transmit Telemetry messages without explicit owner opt-in. The default configuration from the factory MUST have Telemetry transmission disabled. PerceptionSummary, Intent, GroupState, and Attestation are NOT subject to opt-in; they are safety-functional and are required for participation in cooperative perception at all.

## 10.5 Prohibited Analyses

Implementers and operators MUST NOT:

- Attempt to link pseudonym certificate IDs to enrollment identities except through the SCMS linkage mechanism, and only in the course of a properly-authorized misbehavior investigation.
- Construct long-term movement traces of individual vehicles from O-CPS data.
- Sell, trade, or disclose O-CPS-derived data to advertising networks or data brokers.
- Retain Telemetry data beyond the limits in §10.3 without explicit, revocable consent.
